The cost model counts SSA instructions, so I tried removing the two `_ = xs[N]` bounds-check hints. The reasoning is below, and I haven't run the change.

In SSA, `_ = xs[15]` still emits an `IndexAddr` and a load. The interpreter does the bounds check inside `IndexAddr` itself, so the hint doesn't remove any later checks. It only adds instructions.

Attempt 2 supports this. Adding one more hint (`_ = xs[11]`) raised the cost from 3661 to 3683, so each hint costs about 2 instructions per path that reaches it. The 16-word peel and the 8–15 ladder branch are both hot, so dropping those two hints should lower the cost.
